item.title: Andersson assists on three goals for Flames in 4-2 win over Kraken
item.description: CALGARY — Rasmus Andersson assisted on three goals for the Calgary Flames in a 4-2 win over the visiting Seattle Kraken on Thursday.

item.description: ATLANTA (AP) — When Donald Trump delivered the first White House address of his second presidency Wednesday night, all major U.S. networks beamed his image and voice onto their airwaves, cable feeds and online platforms.

item.title: McDavid scores, assists as Oilers beat Bruins 3-1
item.description: BOSTON (AP) — Connor McDavid scored on a short-handed breakaway and set up Ryan Nugent-Hopkins’ power-play score, helping the Edmonton Oilers beat the Boston Bruins 3-1 on Thursday night.

item.title: Trump suspends green card lottery program that let Brown University, MIT shootings suspect into US
item.description: President Donald Trump suspended the green card lottery program on Thursday that allowed the suspect in the Brown University and MIT shootings to come to the United States.

item.title: Canada to begin formal talks with U.S. in January on review of free trade deal
item.description: OTTAWA — Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will enter into formal discussions with the United States in January to review their free trade agreement.
